candidate_windows.window_text: The threshold $\theta = 0.5$ is used in the binary span classifier. We use the AdamW optimizer (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2018) with a linear warmup. The learning rate starts from 5e-5 and is reduced by a linear decay learning rate schedule until 0. We mostly use the hyper-parameters in (Eberts and Ulges, 2020) with minor adjustments to better suit each dataset. We provide more hyperparameters of ScdNER on five benchmark NER datasets in Table 9. We train all models using a Tesla V100 GPU. For the baseline model results we produced, we used the hyper-parameters reported in the original paper, albeit with slight fine-tuning.
